chunks: Ja'far ibn Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Kufi (may God be pleased with him) narrated from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ali ibn Hassam, from his uncle Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir al-Hashimi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When four things spread, four things will appear: When adultery spreads, earthquakes will appear; when alms-tax is withheld, livestock will perish; when the ruler is unjust in judgment, rain will be withheld from the sky; and when the covenant of protection is broken, polytheists will defeat the Muslims.
ai.seo_question: What are the four social sins and their corresponding divine punishments according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Al-Khisal*, this hadith establishes a cosmological link between societal moral decay and natural or political consequences, reflecting the Shia concept of divine retribution in this world. It emphasizes that judicial injustice and breach of treaties (*dhimmah*) are as critical as sexual immorality and economic negligence in disrupting the balance of the universe.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-95 Ja’far ibn Ali ibn al-Hassan al-Kufy - may God be pleased with him - narrated that his grandfather ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Muqayrih al-Kufy narrated that his grandfather Al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Muqayrih quoted Ali ibn Hisan, on the authority of his uncle Abdul Rahman ibn Kasir al-Hashemi that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said, “

When there is a lot of adultery, there will be an earthquake. When a lot of people do not pay the alms-tax, quadrupeds will die. When the judges issue unjust decrees, there will be no rain. When the safety of the unbelievers who are under the protection of Islam is denied, unbelievers will defeat the Muslims.”
